subject: Life Skills
title: Why Knives Must Be Sharp
description: Learn Why Knives Must Be Sharp in one minute.

hook.text: Emergency rooms treat more injuries from dull knives than from sharp ones every single year.

buildup.text: A dull blade requires more force. More force means less control and more slipping.

discovery.text: A sharp knife grips the food surface on contact. You guide instead of push.

twist.text: Most home cooks fear sharp knives. Ironically, the safer tool is the one that scares them more.

climax.text: Hone your knife on a steel rod before each use. A quick sharpen keeps it safe for months.

punchline.text: A sharp knife cuts food. A dull one cuts you.

quiz.question: Why are dull knives more dangerous?
options: They rust faster than sharp ones
They require more force and slip easily
They are usually older and lower quality
